# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Patched the shrimp molt runtime so disabling GH minimums no longer triggers a false `critical_molt_gh_ratio` hard fail, and replaced the hidden `0.25` molt-cadence temperature clamp with the named `temp_condition_min_factor` floor plus a defensive `0.01` denominator guard. I strengthened regressions to assert successful molts when all mineral minimums are disabled, updated cold-path tests to use the named cadence floor, added a dedicated cadence-floor regression, and added runtime validation coverage that `temp_condition_min_factor = 0.0` remains valid; the preset-layer zero-floor validation fix was already present on the branch and was revalidated in this pass.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the pending amendments and confirmed the two runtime issues still reproduced in `molt_cycle`, while the preset-layer `temp_condition_min_factor = 0.0` validation fix was already present and needed only revalidation.
2. [Completed] Updated `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs` to skip the critical-GH deficit override when `gh_min_d` is disabled and to drive molt cadence from the named `temp_condition_min_factor` floor instead of the hidden `0.25` clamp.
3. [Completed] Extended `molt_mineral_budget.rs`, `events.rs`, and `validation.rs` so the zero-minimum mineral case asserts `last_molt_success`, cold-path readiness uses the named cadence floor, cadence-floor behavior is explicitly regression-tested, and runtime validation locks in `temp_condition_min_factor = 0.0` acceptance.
4. [Completed] Ran formatting plus focused and broad validation across `tank_core`, `tank_data`, and `tank_scenarios` to verify the runtime fixes and the already-present preset validation contract end to end.

## Validation Evidence

- cargo fmt --all
- cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture
- cargo test -p tank_core --test events -- --nocapture
- cargo test -p tank_core --test validation -- --nocapture
- cargo test -p tank_data -- --nocapture
- cargo test -p tank_scenarios -- --nocapture
- cargo test -p tank_core -- --nocapture

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
